decisions.reason: Locked d1 correctly lists {{قاموس دورلاند|...}} at cp 304 as a citation template. Guide 3.1 defines citation templates by purpose: 'templates whose purpose is to format a citation: Cite ..., Citation, استشهاد ..., Cite Q, and similar'. In render.html this template is the whole content of the footnote and renders a formatted citation of one entry of a named reference work (cite_note-1: '"Mönckeberg arteriosclerosis" في معجم دورلاند الطبي', linking the Dorland's entry one/000008416). Its only purpose is to cite that source entry, so it is a source-specific citation template ('and similar'). The guide is ambiguous here because the template is not a generic Cite/استشهاد template and does not produce CS1 <cite> markup, but the guide's test is purpose, not family. The alternative reading also fails on its own terms: 'unstructured' means citing 'in plain text with no citation template (bare URL, hand-written reference)', and this footnote has no plain-text citation, only the template.
